clips.send: Put the possessive before the noun. Match the number of the noun that follows, such as one cousin or several cousins. Nuestro also changes with the noun’s gender.

clips.send: The article el or la is part of the vocabulary cue. Los padres usually means “parents” in family introductions.

clips.send: In su hermana, su can mean his, her, your or their. To name the person, use la hermana de Leo for “Leo’s sister.”
